description: Curated public-reference metadata. URLs are recorded, not fetched or verified by the toolkit.

sources.title: Motorola HANOIP Android 12 kernel source release
sources.supports: Motorola issue #559 ties the exact XT2135-2 firmware build to this tag. The tag resolves to commit f6673a1302e3b9ca84c54e956ad4075d676fdf59 (Linux 4.14.190); the source tree contains ARM64 HANOIP overlays, an SDMMAGPIE SoC description, and ARMv8 CPU nodes.
sources.limitations: Tag is unsigned. Source inspection does not establish retail SoC marketing name or silicon revision, the exact EVT/DVT board in a particular handset, UEFI/boot-chain behavior, or XNU support. Review each file's license before reuse.
